identity.title: Sanitized Windows Runtime Envelope And Startup Preflight
identity.objective: Replace the artificially tiny controlled-child environment (PATH/SystemRoot/TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL plus HERMES_HOME/HERMES_MANAGED_DIR) with a deterministic platform-aware SANITIZED RUNTIME ENVELOPE that forwards a bounded, explicit allowlist of ordinary Windows runtime variables (real benign parent home/AppData paths) so pinned Hermes profile/default-home resolution and Python Path.home() succeed, while keeping the existing secret-name rejection and adding an explicit interpreter/shell/capability injection denylist so no ambient provider credential or injection variable reaches the child. Add a second OFFLINE startup/profile-init preflight (hermes --help) that exercises the exact default-home path the version fast-path skips, using the same sanitized envelope and a throwaway HERMES_HOME; a startup-preflight failure is terminal STARTUP_PREFLIGHT_FAILED with transport_attempt_count 0 and consumes no H1 research slot. This changes only the controlled wrapper runtime and preflight; provider/model, toolset, retry/fallback, managed profile, request/draft/receipt schemas, and controller research failure precedence are unchanged. WP175L does not repair Hermes, activate the runtime, authorize any H1 run, or unlock Alpha.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175L. The sanitized runtime envelope (renamed from _minimal_env to _build_sanitized_runtime_env with the Windows allowlist and injection denylist), the HermesStartupProbe dataclass and probe_startup on both backends, the controller startup preflight and STARTUP_PREFLIGHT_FAILED status, their focused tests, the WP175L package records, and narrow current-truth updates are removed. The runner reverts to the neutral-only environment; no receipt schema, policy identity, managed config, request/draft schema, dependency, workflow, credential, provider, Firecrawl, order, Gate-C, Alpha, or live state exists to unwind.

api_matrix.reason: WP175L changes the controlled child's runtime environment builder and adds an offline startup preflight; it adds no research surface and no receipt/request/draft schema field.

items.before: Forwarded only PATH/SystemRoot/TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL plus an explicit HERMES_HOME; ordinary Windows home/AppData context was absent, so pinned Hermes profile-home resolution and Python Path.home() raised 'Could not determine home directory.'
items.after: A deterministic platform-aware allowlist also forwards real benign Windows runtime variables (USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, COMSPEC, PATHEXT, WINDIR, OS, PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE, NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS, PROGRAMDATA, PROGRAMFILES, PROGRAMFILES(X86), COMMONPROGRAMFILES); the secret-name rejection is retained and an explicit interpreter/shell/capability injection denylist is added; no ambient provider credential or injection variable is forwarded; HERMES_HOME/HERMES_MANAGED_DIR/HERMES_SAFE_MODE/HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS semantics are unchanged.
items.compatibility_requirement: Allowlist-only (never os.environ.copy()); the private symbol is used only by runner.py and test_runner.py; no public API changes.

items.before: The backend exposed only probe_version (answered by the Hermes fast-version path) and invoke; nothing exercised the profile/default-home path before a paid research invocation.
items.after: Adds a bounded OFFLINE startup/profile-init preflight (hermes --help) on both backends returning HermesStartupProbe(launched,timed_out,exit_code,stdout_truncated), using the same sanitized envelope and a throwaway HERMES_HOME; it forwards no provider secret and makes no research/provider/Firecrawl/network call.
items.compatibility_requirement: Additive backend method and dataclass; FakeHermesBackend defaults to startup success so existing controller tests are unaffected; no receipt schema change.

items.before: After the version preflight the controller went straight to the research invocation.
items.after: Adds a startup preflight between the version preflight and research; a launch failure, timeout, or nonzero exit is terminal STARTUP_PREFLIGHT_FAILED with transport_attempt_count 0 and no research invocation, so no H1 research slot is consumed; research failure precedence is otherwise unchanged.
items.compatibility_requirement: terminal_status is a free receipt string (no models schema change); the new value is additive and does not alter existing failure precedence.

semantic_fields.reason: The sanitized envelope forwards benign Windows runtime context while excluding every secret/injection variable, and the startup preflight gates research on a clean profile-home resolution.

items.required_rule: on Windows the child receives the real benign parent values for the frozen runtime allowlist so profile-home resolution and Path.home() succeed
items.validation_rule: only allowlisted names are forwarded; a fabricated home is never synthesized

items.required_rule: no secret-named variable and no interpreter/shell/capability injection variable is ever forwarded to the child
items.validation_rule: secret-name rejection plus explicit injection denylist; allowlist is disjoint from both boundaries

items.required_rule: a nonzero exit, timeout, or launch failure of the offline startup preflight blocks research; a clean exit (0) allows the normal controller path
items.validation_rule: a startup-preflight failure leaves transport_attempt_count 0 and consumes no research slot
